需要填写谁的模型密钥？: Whose model key should I use?
请填写你自己在对应供应商申请的 Token 或 API Key。本项目不提供共享: Use your own Token or API key from each selected supplier. The project provides no shared credentials. Unconfigured suppliers cannot generate content.
需要先按 README 安装并启动本地服务，再通过浏览器访问。模型请求由你的本地: Install and start the local service using the README, then open it in your browser. Your local service sends model requests and saves projects and generated media on your computer.
模型供应商按你自己的账号与实际用量计费。本地应用不销售金币，也不处理充值或支付。: The model supplier bills your own account for usage. The local application does not sell credits or process top-ups or payments.
是否收费以对应模型供应商的计费规则为准。重试可能产生新的模型请求与费用，请先查看: Charges depend on the selected supplier’s rules. Retrying may create another billable model request; inspect the task error first.
为什么要设置自己的模型账号？: Why do I need my own model account?
生成请求直接使用你填写的供应商凭证。本地工作区不分配共享额度，也不会代替你向供应: Generation requests use the supplier credentials you provide. The local workspace provides no shared allowance and does not purchase supplier usage for you.
在哪里查看模型费用和生成记录？: Where can I view model costs and generation history?
实际费用请到对应模型供应商的控制台查看；任务进度与生成结果可以在本地项目和素材页: Check actual charges in your model supplier’s console. Task progress and generated results are available in local project and asset pages.
项目和素材保存在哪里？: Where are projects and assets saved?
项目记录保存到本地数据目录，素材保存在其中的 media 子目录。无需在线登录，: Project records are saved in the local data directory, with media in its media subdirectory. No online sign-in is required. Back up these files regularly.
模型账号额度不足怎么办？: What if my model account runs out of quota?
请到你使用的模型供应商控制台查看账号额度，或切换到另一个已配置个人密钥的供应商。: Check your account quota in the selected supplier’s console, or choose another supplier configured with your own key.
